answer: CHAIN RULE: After a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at omi: the pair (omi, ldz) comes first; its second item is ldz, so the next pair is the one whose first item is ldz: (ldz, omi). Its second item is omi, but omi never appears as a first item - so omi is the dangling end of the chain.
